_meta.citation: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Agricultural Research Service. FoodData Central: FNDDS 2021-2023 (October 2024) and SR Legacy (April 2018). https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/
_meta.notes: FNDDS 2021-2023 and SR Legacy nutrient values are per 100 g. Direct matches identify a matching prepared food item or cut; approximate matches use a linked nearest USDA record and are labeled. Unmatched Food-101 classes retain provisional calorie-only values from the provided calories.json. Nutrition for user-entered portions is scaled from per-100-g values and remains an estimate for the pictured dish.
